title: The Story Character Given Your Scarf
youtube_title: The Story Character Given Your Scarf | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude shows up in what you do next.
summary: At a workshop with tools on a low peg, Una notices that Papa has already taken care of a story character given your scarf in the telling. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Una does one useful thing Papa did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
